g.text: Sequential removals depend on display order, not importance; independent layer effects are in independent-layer-effects.csv. Rare vital-tissue cell expression (brain, heart, lung alveolar, endothelial and airway basal cells; at least 1%) marks 15,874 proteins Unsafe.
